label: WaterTAP Two-Stage Mother-Liquor Crystallization
request: Build and solve a two-stage NaCl crystallization train for 10.5119 kg/s NaCl and 38.9326 kg/s water. Operate the first crystallizer at 328.15 K and 40% NaCl yield, route only its liquid mother liquor to a second crystallizer at 318.15 K and 40% stage yield, and keep each stage's crystals and vapor separate. Report incremental and overall salt recovery, remaining mother-liquor salt, vapor production, and stage heat duties.
